---
applyTo: "site/**,docs/runbooks/**"
---

# Generated files

`site/*.html` and `docs/runbooks/*.md` are generated by `scripts/build_docs.py`
from sources in `docs/content/`. They carry a `Generated by …` header.

A hand edit to one of these files is a defect. Flag it, and say which source it
belongs in:

- a section shared by several pages: `docs/content/blocks/`;
- text specific to one site page: `docs/content/pages/`;
- text specific to one runbook: `docs/content/runbooks/`.

The fix is to change the source and run `make docs`. `make validate` fails when
the output differs from the source, so an edit here is also a broken build.

Two exceptions: `site/styles.css` and `site/docs.js` are not generated. Review
them normally.
